in_text_mentions: On examination, he had two localized areas of erythematous umbilicated papules arranged in a serpiginous pattern on both the left and right side of his posterior neck (Figure 1). A biopsy had been performed at his previous centre of care and a diagnosis of EPS was confirmed. An EPS biopsy, as shown on DermNet.nz, shows keratotic debris columns perforating through a hyperplastic epidermis. This can be accentuated using an Elastic-Van Gieson stain that highlights elastic fibres in black (Figure 2) [5].
